create_VariationalWorld: create a VariationalWorld instance with observations, params, and queries_to_guides mappings
copy_VariationalWorld: copy a VariationalWorld instance to create an independent duplicate with all state
get_param_VariationalWorld: get or initialize a variational parameter tensor by its RVIdentifier key
set_params_VariationalWorld: set all variational parameters in the world to a new mapping of tensors
get_guide_distribution_VariationalWorld: get the guide distribution for a query random variable via its RVIdentifier
